One synchronous call per launch. The four folder states
are variations of one operation, not four operations. An
unreachable symlink target counts as missing. Creating
the folder is what brings the Chores board into existence.
The day in play is set to the current date here, from no

Editing, removing and adding are three operations, not

Every form on this surface drafts as it is filled in, so
leaving it half-finished, a crash and a restart all cost
nothing. The draft is one-way: nothing waits for it to be
kept. Whichever write commits the form discards it.
Reached from either wizard step: skipping is the same
act as completing, minus what was skipped.
